source.author: Go course authors (drafted by an AI model)

source.provenance: Drafted by an AI model for the course ladder in contemporary Bokmål (2005 norm); not reviewed by a native speaker. It is controlled, deliberately repetitive Norwegian written for learners and may contain unnatural phrasing. Facts about Norway and Bergen are general knowledge and unchecked. The English lines are the drafter's own.

review.notes: Machine-drafted by an AI model; awaiting native-speaker review. House style: moderate Bokmål with three genders (ei/-a for feminine nouns, en/-en masculine, et/-et neuter), weak past in -et, neuter definite plural in -ene, sju and tjue, "ble", "ga". "synes" (think, have an opinion) and "mene" (mean, think) are close; "kanskje" means maybe. A friendly disagreement about the weather and the food.

english.source: drafted with the text; not reviewed

sentences.text: Hva synes du om været i Bergen, Sam?
sentences.english: What do you think about the weather in Bergen, Sam?
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Jeg synes at det er bra. Jeg liker regn.
sentences.english: I think it is good. I like rain.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Liker du regn? Det synes ikke jeg.
sentences.english: Do you like rain? I do not think so.
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Jeg mener at sola er bra. Jeg liker sola mer enn regn.
sentences.english: I think the sun is good. I like the sun more than rain.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Er du enig, Lars?
sentences.english: Do you agree, Lars?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Ja, jeg er enig med Anna. Men regnet er ikke dårlig.
sentences.english: Yes, I agree with Anna. But the rain is not bad.
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Jeg er ikke enig. Regn er vann, og vann er bra!
sentences.english: I do not agree. Rain is water, and water is good!
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Kanskje du har rett. Vi har mye vann i Bergen.
sentences.english: Maybe you are right. We have a lot of water in Bergen.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Hva mener du om maten min, Sam?
sentences.english: What do you think about my food, Sam?
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Maten din er veldig bra! Den er ikke dårlig.
sentences.english: Your food is very good! It is not bad.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Jeg synes at fisk ikke er bra. Jeg liker brød.
sentences.english: I think fish is not good. I like bread.
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Nei, Nils! Fisk er bra mat. Er du enig, Sam?
sentences.english: No, Nils! Fish is good food. Do you agree, Sam?
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Ja, jeg er enig med deg, Marta. Jeg liker fisk og poteter.
sentences.english: Yes, I agree with you, Marta. I like fish and potatoes.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Kanskje jeg liker fisk i morgen.
sentences.english: Maybe I will like fish tomorrow.
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Ja, det kan være! Du liker kake mer enn fisk, hver dag.
sentences.english: Yes, that may be! You like cake more than fish, every day.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Hva synes du om søndagen i Bergen, Sam?
sentences.english: What do you think about Sundays in Bergen, Sam?
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Jeg synes at søndagen er den beste dagen. Vi går til kirka, og vi spiser middag hos Marta.
sentences.english: I think Sunday is the best day. We go to church, and we have dinner at Marta's.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Jeg er enig. Jeg mener at søndagen er en bra dag. Men jeg er ofte trøtt.
sentences.english: I agree. I think Sunday is a good day. But I am often tired.
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Det er ikke dårlig å være trøtt på søndag!
sentences.english: It is not bad to be tired on Sunday!
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Vi er ikke alltid enige, men vi er alltid venner.
sentences.english: We do not always agree, but we are always friends.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Hvis jeg ikke forstår, spør jeg. Når jeg spør, forstår jeg. Det er ikke vanskelig.
sentences.english: If I do not understand, I ask. When I ask, I understand. It is not difficult.

sentences.text: Noen ganger kjørte Marta hesten til markedet. Den var gammel, men hun var glad i den.
sentences.english: Sometimes Marta drove the horse to the market. It was old, but she was fond of it.

sentences.text: Bussen var forsinket, og Lars kjørte bilen. Det var nesten sent.
sentences.english: The bus was late, and Lars drove the car. It was almost late.

sentences.text: Anna har bunad, og hun feirer sytten mai.
sentences.english: Anna has a bunad, and she celebrates the seventeenth of May.
